claims: NASA's Orion spacecraft is a deep-space vehicle designed for the Artemis program to carry astronauts to the Moon and eventually Mars
NASA's Orion spacecraft supports crews of four for up to 21 days
Orion spacecraft functions as a crew habitat
Orion spacecraft provides life support
Orion spacecraft provides heat shielding up to 2700°C for high-speed re-entry
Orion capsule is built with Lockheed Martin
Orion capsule features radiation protection
Orion capsule has the ability to operate independently for months when docked
Orion capsule is capable of returning from lunar speeds at over 32,000 km/h
Orion capsule accommodates four astronauts
Orion capsule has a habitable volume of 330 cubic feet
Orion capsule habitable volume is 57% more than the Apollo capsules
Orion capsule is composed of the crew module built by Lockheed Martin
Orion capsule is composed of a crew module adapter
Orion capsule is composed of the European Service Module by ESA
Orion capsule utilizes a heat shield for re-entry
Orion capsule utilizes parachutes for a splashdown in the Pacific Ocean
Artemis II mission was in progress as of April 2026
Artemis II mission utilized the Orion capsule
Artemis II mission was a crewed journey around the Moon
Orion is currently the only human-rated spacecraft capable of transporting crews to the Moon's vicinity and returning them to Earth
